milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The agent must navigate close to the cyan stained glass column (at spawn-relative [6, 1, 6]) and face toward it, demonstrating they have identified the correct block among 6 colored glass distractors. max_distance=5 ensures the agent actually approached the cyan column rather than just standing at spawn, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it.
